subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the heartbeat-session precedence bug, or should OpenClaw also change the Telegram `dmScope: "main"` compatibility default?
rationale: Current docs and tests intentionally preserve main-scoped DMs, while the report asks for stricter Telegram isolation; that default change affects existing user session behavior and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow to heartbeat precedence
options.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win over wake-provided session keys and preserve existing `dmScope: "main"` semantics unless a separate migration is approved.

options.title: Migrate Telegram DMs by default
options.body: Change Telegram direct-message defaults toward `per-channel-peer` and require an upgrade/doctor/docs plan for users who relied on shared main-session DMs.

options.title: Document current behavior
options.body: Treat main-scoped DMs as expected, close the isolation request after documenting `session.dmScope` and heartbeat isolation recovery paths.

recommendation.title: Narrow to heartbeat precedence
recommendation.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win over wake-provided session keys and preserve existing `dmScope: "main"` semantics unless a separate migration is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent event-routing work and are the best available decision owner among the likely routing contacts.
